tool.title: Exchange catalogues with a translation platform
tool.description: For Weblate, Crowdin and Transifex: `export` writes the layout file a platform reads from the layer's declared `translation-sources` directory; `import` turns the `.po` changes a platform pushed onto the checked-out branch into CANDIDATES, never adjudications. Nothing here talks to a platform or the network. Exit 0 done, 1 `--check` found drift, 3 import found nothing to rewrite, 2 could not determine.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The layer root. Default: the current directory.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: import: the git ref the platform's changes are compared against.

inputs.name: write
inputs.description: export: write the platform's file rather than print it.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: export: fail when the committed file differs from what would be written.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: import: plan and report, write nothing.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: The file written or the candidates recorded.

selection.when: When a layer offers its catalogues to a translation platform, and when the platform's import workflow brings its changes back as candidates.
selection.limits: Reads and writes files only; the platform's own push and pull happen outside it.
selection.cost: One read of the layer's catalogues. No network.
